records.context: The ``activation`` workflow remains distinct from machine-learning classification model training: it uses its own settings form, Run action, console, and hyperparameter-search structured-data name, and :func:`spacr.qt.bridge.resolve_pipeline_entry` dispatches it to ``generate_activation_map``. The Classify masthead opens that workflow as a folded page so attribution results remain associated with the trained model without combining the two workflow processing sessions.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.activation#1
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: The ``activation`` workflow remains distinct from classifier training: it uses its own settings form, Run action, console, and hyperparameter-search key, and :func:`spacr.qt.bridge.resolve_pipeline_entry` dispatches it to ``generate_activation_map``. The Classify masthead opens that workflow as a folded page so attribution results remain associated with the trained model without combining the two pipeline runs.
records.translation: Arbetsflödet ``activation`` hålls åtskilt från klassificerarträning: det har ett eget inställningsformulär, en egen Run-åtgärd, en egen konsol och en egen nyckel för hyperparametersökning, och :func:`spacr.qt.bridge.resolve_pipeline_entry` skickar det vidare till ``generate_activation_map``. Classify-mastheaden öppnar arbetsflödet som en hopfälld sida, så att attributionsresultaten förblir kopplade till den tränade modellen utan att de två pipelinekörningarna slås ihop.

records.context: The Annotate app writes one ``INTEGER`` column per pass into ``png_list``. records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: The Annotate app writes one ``INTEGER`` column per pass into ``png_list``. Two people labelling the same crops therefore leave two columns side by side, and this screen reports whether they agree, and on which rows they differ, before either set is used as ground truth.
records.translation: Annotate-appen skriver en ``INTEGER``-kolumn per genomgång i ``png_list``. Två personer som annoterar samma utsnitt lämnar därför två kolumner sida vid sida, och den här skärmen rapporterar om de är överens, och på vilka rader de skiljer sig, innan någon av uppsättningarna används som facit.

records.source: Ordering matters throughout and is the reason for the length. The live preview watches ``src`` and can only be wired once both panels exist, because the settings panel owns the field and the runtime panel owns the preview. The category hints have the same constraint in reverse. The page-surface sweep runs on every route, not only where a backdrop was installed: with the ambient preference off, skipping it left every layout container carrying the blanket window fill, which is what made the settings half a solid slab.
records.translation: Ordningen spelar roll genomgående och är skälet till längden. Liveförhandsvisningen bevakar ``src`` och kan bara kopplas in när båda panelerna finns, eftersom inställningspanelen äger fältet och körningspanelen äger förhandsvisningen. Genomgången av sidytor körs på varje väg, inte bara där en bakgrund installerades: med omgivningsinställningen avstängd lämnade ett överhopp varje layoutbehållare med fönstrets heltäckande fyllnad, vilket var det som gjorde inställningshalvan till en enfärgad platta.

records.context: Only Home is rebuilt when the theme changes; every other application view is re-styled in place by re-applying the QSS. That is enough for anything whose colours come from the stylesheet, and not enough for a backdrop that paints itself — the DNA rain and the ambient background both capture their flat fill colour and their wallpaper at construction. Switching from dark to light left a black rain rectangle on a white page, and switching into Cell left it painting flat black over the micrograph the theme had just loaded. The ambient backdrop has exactly the same two captured values and therefore exactly the same two bugs.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.app_screen.AppScreen.changeEvent#1
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: Only Home is rebuilt when the theme changes; every other screen is re-styled in place by re-applying the QSS. That is enough for anything whose colours come from the stylesheet, and not enough for a backdrop that paints itself — the DNA rain and the ambient background both capture their flat fill colour and their wallpaper at construction. Switching from dark to light left a black rain rectangle on a white page, and switching into Cell left it painting flat black over the micrograph the theme had just loaded. The ambient backdrop has exactly the same two captured values and therefore exactly the same two bugs.
records.translation: Endast Home byggs om när temat ändras; varje annan skärm formateras om på plats genom att QSS tillämpas igen. Det räcker för allt vars färger kommer från formatmallen, men inte för en bakgrund som målar sig själv — DNA-regnet och omgivningsbakgrunden fångar båda sin enfärgade fyllnadsfärg och sin bakgrundsbild när de skapas. Ett byte från mörkt till ljust lämnade en svart regnrektangel på en vit sida, och ett byte till Cell fick den att måla enfärgat svart över mikrofotografiet som temat just hade läst in. Omgivningsbakgrunden har exakt samma två fångade värden och därför exakt samma två buggar.

records.context: Both palette events count, and that is the whole reason this works. ``QApplication.setPalette`` — which is what :func:`spacr.qt.theme.apply_qpalette` ends in — delivers ``ApplicationPaletteChange`` **only to top-level widgets** (Qt 6.11, verified); every child, including every AppScreen inside MainWindow's stack, gets ``PaletteChange`` instead. Listening for the application event alone meant this handler fired in the tests that synthesised it and never once in the running app.

records.source: Both palette events count, and that is the whole reason this works. ``QApplication.setPalette`` — which is what :func:`spacr.qt.theme.apply_qpalette` ends in — delivers ``ApplicationPaletteChange`` **only to top-level widgets** (Qt 6.11, verified); every child, including every AppScreen inside MainWindow's stack, gets ``PaletteChange`` instead. Listening for the application event alone meant this handler fired in the tests that synthesised it and never once in the running app.
records.translation: Båda paletthändelserna räknas, och det är hela skälet till att detta fungerar. ``QApplication.setPalette`` — som är det :func:`spacr.qt.theme.apply_qpalette` slutar i — levererar ``ApplicationPaletteChange`` **endast till widgetar på toppnivå** (Qt 6.11, verifierat); varje barn, inklusive varje AppScreen i stacken i MainWindow, får i stället ``PaletteChange``. Att bara lyssna efter programhändelsen innebar att hanteraren utlöstes i de tester som syntetiserade den och aldrig en enda gång i den körande appen.

records.source: ``app_stage`` answers ``stable`` for a key it has never heard of, which is the right answer for a typo and the wrong one for a module that was folded into a host and had its row deleted: its settings would go from beta-tinted to unmarked on the day the row went, claiming a maturity nobody signed off. So a key with no row is asked of the fold tables, which record what its tile said.
records.translation: ``app_stage`` svarar ``stable`` för en nyckel den aldrig har hört talas om, vilket är rätt svar för ett stavfel och fel svar för en modul som fälldes in i en värd och fick sin rad borttagen: dess inställningar skulle gå från beta-tonade till omärkta den dag raden försvann, och därmed påstå en mognadsgrad som ingen har godkänt. Därför frågas fold-tabellerna om en nyckel utan rad, eftersom de registrerar vad dess ruta angav.

records.context: Every module application view **except** the ones that already animate something of their own — which today is exactly :data:`DNA_RAIN_APPS`. Sequencing's rain is *about* sequencing: bases falling behind the application view that maps reads to barcodes. Putting a second, unrelated animation behind it would fight it — two independent motions competing for the same pixels, neither readable, and two animation timers executing on the one application view that already had one. So an application view gets one animated background or none, never both.

records.source: Every module screen **except** the ones that already animate something of their own — which today is exactly :data:`DNA_RAIN_APPS`. Sequencing's rain is *about* sequencing: bases falling behind the screen that maps reads to barcodes. Putting a second, unrelated animation behind it would fight it — two independent motions competing for the same pixels, neither readable, and two animation timers running on the one screen that already had one. So a screen gets one animated background or none, never both.
records.translation: Varje modulskärm **utom** de som redan animerar något eget — vilket i dag är exakt :data:`DNA_RAIN_APPS`. Sequencings regn handlar *om* sekvensering: baser som faller bakom skärmen som mappar läsningar till streckkoder. Att lägga en andra, orelaterad animation bakom den skulle störa den — två oberoende rörelser som konkurrerar om samma pixlar, ingen av dem läsbar, och två animationstimrar på den enda skärm som redan hade en. Så en skärm får en animerad bakgrund eller ingen, aldrig båda.

records.context: The run uses a worker. **Execution model:** completion returns to the GUI thread. ``PipelineWorker.finished`` is emitted *inside the worker thread*; therefore each receiver that changes a widget uses an explicit queued connection to a bound method of this GUI-thread widget.

records.source: **The run happens off the GUI thread, and its completion handler comes back onto it.** ``PipelineWorker.finished`` is emitted *in the worker thread*; every widget-mutating receiver therefore uses an explicit queued connection to a bound method of this GUI-thread widget.
records.translation: **Körningen sker utanför GUI-tråden, och dess slutförandehanterare kommer tillbaka till den.** ``PipelineWorker.finished`` sänds *i arbetstråden*; varje mottagare som ändrar widgetar använder därför en explicit köad anslutning till en bunden metod i den här widgeten i GUI-tråden.

records.context: A screening campaign is dozens of plates run over weeks, and the analysis assumes that the controls behave the same way every time. Hit calling, plate normalisation and Z' all measure against them, so when the controls drift, every downstream result shifts with them without any warning — the analysis normalises to whatever controls it is handed.

records.source: A screening campaign is dozens of plates run over weeks, and the analysis assumes that the controls behave the same way every time. Hit calling, plate normalisation and Z' all measure against them, so when the controls drift, every downstream result shifts with them without any warning — the analysis normalises to whatever controls it is handed.
records.translation: En screeningkampanj består av dussintals plattor som körs under flera veckor, och analysen förutsätter att kontrollerna beter sig likadant varje gång. Träffidentifiering, plattnormalisering och Z' mäts alla mot dem, så när kontrollerna driver förskjuts varje nedströms resultat med dem utan förvarning — analysen normaliserar mot de kontroller den får.

records.translation: Den här skärmen ritar ett kontrollvärde per platta längs körordningen, med gränser som skattas från en angiven baslinje och tillämpas framåt, och varje Nelson-regel som utlöses markeras på den platta där den utlöstes och namnges i ord nedanför.

records.context: Everything numeric comes from :mod:`spacr.qt.widgets.control_chart`, which has no Qt in it and documents the reasoning for every decision — most of all the central one, that sigma comes from the average moving range over d2 and never from the standard deviation of the series, because the SD is inflated by exactly the drift the chart exists to detect. This file draws that result and nothing else: no statistic is computed here, so the chart on application view and the chart in a report cannot disagree.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.control_chart#3
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: Everything numeric comes from :mod:`spacr.qt.widgets.control_chart`, which has no Qt in it and documents the reasoning for every decision — most of all the central one, that sigma comes from the average moving range over d2 and never from the standard deviation of the series, because the SD is inflated by exactly the drift the chart exists to detect. records.source: **Off the GUI thread.** Scanning a plate's worth of ND2 headers takes seconds; converting takes minutes. Both go through :func:`spacr.qt.bridge.make_thread`, and the completion handler is reached through a *bound method* (:attr:`ConvertScreen._job_settled`) rather than a closure, because ``PipelineWorker.finished`` is emitted in the worker thread and a closure connected to it would build widget children there. Tests pass ``threaded=False``.
records.translation: **Utanför GUI-tråden.** Att skanna ND2-huvudena för en hel platta tar sekunder; att konvertera tar minuter. Båda går via :func:`spacr.qt.bridge.make_thread`, och slutförandehanteraren nås via en *bunden metod* (:attr:`ConvertScreen._job_settled`) snarare än en closure, eftersom ``PipelineWorker.finished`` sänds i arbetstråden och en closure som kopplats till den skulle bygga widgetbarn där. Testerna skickar ``threaded=False``.

records.translation: Den visar summan, postlistan och varje fil som skulle försvinna — samma lista som :meth:`spacr.data_manager.PrunePlan.file_list` returnerar, inte en sammanfattning av den — och dess godkännandeknapp förblir inaktiverad tills användaren markerar rutan som säger att de har läst den. records.context: The dialog fills in two stages. The file list is not stored on the plan: every call to ``file_list`` runs ``os.walk`` over every candidate directory, because a plan for a project with millions of extracted image regions must not carry millions of strings. Doing that in ``__init__`` would put a full recursive walk of the user's project on the main GUI execution path, at the one moment they are waiting for a window to appear — and on a share that is asleep, the walk's first stat alone can take twenty seconds while the mount wakes. So the dialog opens with the half that needs nothing from the disk (the totals, every candidate, every kept item and its reason) and the file list arrives behind it. Nothing is dropped: the user still reads every path before anything is deleted, which is why the acknowledgement is held disabled until the list is on application view — or, when the walk fails, until :meth:`_on_listing_failed` has said so in the list's place. The box is never enabled while the list shows a placeholder.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.data_manager.ConfirmDeleteDialog#2
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: The dialog fills in two stages. The file list is not stored on the plan: every call to ``file_list`` runs ``os.walk`` over every candidate directory, because a plan for a project with millions of crops must not carry millions of strings. Doing that in ``__init__`` would put a full recursive walk of the user's project on the GUI thread, at the one moment they are waiting for a window to appear — and on a share that is asleep, the walk's first stat alone can take twenty seconds while the mount wakes. So the dialog opens with the half that needs nothing from the disk (the totals, every candidate, every kept item and its reason) and the file list arrives behind it. Nothing is dropped: the user still reads every path before anything is deleted, which is why the acknowledgement is held disabled until the list is on screen — or, when the walk fails, until :meth:`_on_listing_failed` has said so in the list's place. The box is never enabled while the list shows a placeholder.
records.translation: Dialogen fylls i två steg. Fillistan lagras inte i planen: varje anrop till ``file_list`` kör ``os.walk`` över varje kandidatkatalog, eftersom en plan för ett projekt med miljontals utsnitt inte får bära miljontals strängar. Att göra det i ``__init__`` skulle lägga en fullständig rekursiv genomgång av användarens projekt i GUI-tråden, just i det ögonblick användaren väntar på att ett fönster ska visas — och på en nätverksresurs som har somnat kan genomgångens första stat ensam ta tjugo sekunder medan monteringen vaknar. Därför öppnas dialogen med den halva som inte behöver något från disken (summorna, varje kandidat, varje behållen post och skälet) och fillistan kommer efter. Ingenting utelämnas: användaren läser fortfarande varje sökväg innan något tas bort, vilket är skälet till att bekräftelsen hålls inaktiverad tills listan visas på skärmen — eller, när genomgången misslyckas, tills :meth:`_on_listing_failed` har sagt det i listans ställe. Rutan aktiveras aldrig medan listan visar en platshållare.

records.context: **Refusals and one-sided bounds are rows, not silence.** A laboratory microplate where three compounds fit and the fourth is cytotoxic at the top dose has four rows. The cytotoxic one says ``refused`` and carries the engine's message; a compound whose midpoint sits past the highest dose says ``unbounded`` and carries ``EC50 > 30 µM``, with an empty EC50 cell. records.context: **The channel policy is the first control on the screen.** How channels are combined must not be decided implicitly by whatever the backbone expects. Per-channel encoding keeps the channel in every column name and costs N forward passes; projection mixes the channels into three and costs one. Those produce columns of identical width and dtype that mean entirely different things, so the screen makes the choice explicit and says what each one costs.

records.source: **The channel policy is the first control on the screen.** How channels are combined must not be decided implicitly by whatever the backbone expects. Per-channel encoding keeps the channel in every column name and costs N forward passes; projection mixes the channels into three and costs one. Those produce columns of identical width and dtype that mean entirely different things, so the screen makes the choice explicit and says what each one costs.
records.translation: **Kanalpolicyn är den första kontrollen på skärmen.** Hur kanaler kombineras får inte avgöras underförstått av vad stommodellen råkar förvänta sig. Kodning per kanal behåller kanalen i varje kolumnnamn och kostar N framåtpass; projektion blandar kanalerna till tre och kostar ett. De ger kolumner med identisk bredd och dtype som betyder helt olika saker, så skärmen gör valet uttryckligt och anger vad vart och ett kostar.

records.context: The laboratory microplate drawing is shared where it can be. The square, the constant it is pitched at and the row/column headers come from :mod:`spacr.qt.widgets.plate_map_picker` rather than being declared a second time here; the two laboratory microplates had already drifted apart once. What cannot be shared is the well itself, and the difference is functional: the picker's well is a checkable ``QPushButton`` whose checked state IS the selection and which paints itself from a fixed pair of colours, while this one is a ``QLabel`` carrying a role, an edge mark, a name and a condition, painted by the theme through the properties below -- a laboratory microplate map that says what each well holds rather than only whether it is chosen.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.experiment_design#7
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: The plate drawing is shared where it can be. The square, the constant it is pitched at and the row/column headers come from :mod:`spacr.qt.widgets.plate_map_picker` rather than being declared a second time here; the two plates had already drifted apart once. What cannot be shared is the well itself, and the difference is functional: the picker's well is a checkable ``QPushButton`` whose checked state IS the selection and which paints itself from a fixed pair of colours, while this one is a ``QLabel`` carrying a role, an edge mark, a name and a condition, painted by the theme through the properties below -- a plate map that says what each well holds rather than only whether it is chosen.
records.translation: Plattritningen delas där det går. Kvadraten, konstanten den är dimensionerad efter och rad- och kolumnrubrikerna kommer från :mod:`spacr.qt.widgets.plate_map_picker` i stället för att deklareras en andra gång här; de två plattorna hade redan glidit isär en gång. Det som inte kan delas är själva brunnen, och skillnaden är funktionell: väljarens brunn är en markerbar ``QPushButton`` vars markerade tillstånd ÄR urvalet och som målar sig själv med ett fast färgpar, medan den här är en ``QLabel`` som bär en roll, en kantmarkering, ett namn och ett tillstånd, målad av temat via egenskaperna nedan -- en plattkarta som säger vad varje brunn innehåller snarare än bara om den är vald.

records.context: :mod:`spacr.foreign` does the work; this screen is for the step that needs review. A foreign ``Area`` can be in µm² where spaCR's ``cell_area`` is in px², so an unreviewed mapping can give values that look plausible and are wrong by a factor of several hundred. So the mapping table is the middle of the screen, it is **editable**, and every edit re-runs the conflict and unit checks in place.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.foreign#1
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: :mod:`spacr.foreign` does the work; this screen is for the step that needs review. A foreign ``Area`` can be in µm² where spaCR's ``cell_area`` is in px², so an unreviewed mapping can give values that look plausible and are wrong by a factor of several hundred. So the mapping table is the middle of the screen, it is **editable**, and every edit re-runs the conflict and unit checks in place.
records.translation: :mod:`spacr.foreign` gör arbetet; den här skärmen är till för det steg som kräver granskning. En främmande ``Area`` kan vara i µm² där spaCR:s ``cell_area`` är i px², så en ogranskad mappning kan ge värden som ser rimliga ut men är fel med en faktor på flera hundra. Därför är mappningstabellen skärmens mitt, den är **redigerbar**, och varje ändring kör om konflikt- och enhetskontrollerna på plats.

records.translation: **Redigering är omedelbar och lokal.** En celländring anropar :meth:`spacr.foreign.ImportPlan.with_column_maps`, som löser upp kolumnerna på nytt utan att röra disken, så att listan över omappade kolumner, konfliktlistan och Import-knappen uppdateras medan du skriver.

records.context: **Off the main GUI execution path.** Scanning a plate of TIFFs and reading every label image takes seconds; the import takes minutes. Both go through :func:`spacr.qt.bridge.make_thread`, and the completion handler is reached through a *bound method* (:attr:`ForeignScreen._job_settled`) rather than a closure, because ``PipelineWorker.finished`` is emitted in the background execution unit and a closure connected to it would build widget children there. Tests pass ``threaded=False``.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.foreign#6
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: **Off the GUI thread.** Scanning a plate of TIFFs and reading every label image takes seconds; the import takes minutes. Both go through :func:`spacr.qt.bridge.make_thread`, and the completion handler is reached through a *bound method* (:attr:`ForeignScreen._job_settled`) rather than a closure, because ``PipelineWorker.finished`` is emitted in the worker thread and a closure connected to it would build widget children there. Tests pass ``threaded=False``.
records.translation: **Utanför GUI-tråden.** Att skanna en platta med TIFFs och läsa varje etikettbild tar sekunder; importen tar minuter. Båda går via :func:`spacr.qt.bridge.make_thread`, och slutförandehanteraren nås via en *bunden metod* (:attr:`ForeignScreen._job_settled`) snarare än en closure, eftersom ``PipelineWorker.finished`` sänds i arbetstråden och en closure som kopplats till den skulle bygga widgetbarn där. Testerna skickar ``threaded=False``.

records.context: The row itself -- the structured-data name, the name, the blurb, the section, the "no headless run" sentence, the API doc link and the nine translations of the display name -- is declared in :mod:`spacr.qt.app_catalog`. :func:`spacr.qt.app.register_app` distributes those into the four tables each used to need a hand-edit in, and this function's whole job is to name which row. That is what lets the app be registered without importing this module at all: the launch reads the table, and the application view is imported when somebody opens it.

records.source: The row itself -- the key, the name, the blurb, the section, the "no headless run" sentence, the API doc link and the nine translations of the display name -- is declared in :mod:`spacr.qt.app_catalog`. :func:`spacr.qt.app.register_app` distributes those into the four tables each used to need a hand-edit in, and this function's whole job is to name which row. That is what lets the app be registered without importing this module at all: the launch reads the table, and the screen is imported when somebody opens it.

records.context: Nothing here touches the file on the main GUI execution path. The read executes on a background execution unit -- ``SELECT * FROM cell`` into pandas measures 1.5 s for a 200 000-row measurement table on a warm local SSD -- and listing the tables runs there too, even though one ``sqlite_master`` query costs 0.4 ms, because that cost holds only for a disk that answers. Measured on one workstation, a single ``stat`` under ``/nas_mnt`` -- an ``autofs`` mount whose share was asleep -- had not returned after twenty seconds, and ``sqlite3.connect`` opens the file before it can read a byte of ``sqlite_master``. Picking a measurements.db off a sleeping share, or dropping a project folder that resolves onto one, would freeze the whole window with no traceback.

records.source: Nothing here touches the file on the GUI thread. The read runs on a worker thread -- ``SELECT * FROM cell`` into pandas measures 1.5 s for a 200 000-row measurement table on a warm local SSD -- and listing the tables runs there too, even though one ``sqlite_master`` query costs 0.4 ms, because that cost holds only for a disk that answers. Measured on one workstation, a single ``stat`` under ``/nas_mnt`` -- an ``autofs`` mount whose share was asleep -- had not returned after twenty seconds, and ``sqlite3.connect`` opens the file before it can read a byte of ``sqlite_master``. Picking a measurements.db off a sleeping share, or dropping a project folder that resolves onto one, would freeze the whole window with no traceback.
records.translation: Ingenting här rör filen i GUI-tråden. Läsningen körs i en arbetstråd -- ``SELECT * FROM cell`` till pandas tar uppmätt 1.5 s för en mättabell med 200 000 rader på en varm lokal SSD -- och listningen av tabellerna körs också där, trots att en ``sqlite_master``-fråga kostar 0.4 ms, eftersom den kostnaden bara gäller för en disk som svarar. Uppmätt på en arbetsstation hade en enda ``stat`` under ``/nas_mnt`` -- en ``autofs``-montering vars nätverksresurs hade somnat -- inte returnerat efter tjugo sekunder, och ``sqlite3.connect`` öppnar filen innan den kan läsa en enda byte av ``sqlite_master``. Att välja en measurements.db från en sovande nätverksresurs, eller släppa en projektmapp som pekar dit, skulle frysa hela fönstret utan någon traceback.

records.source: Hyperparameter search panel, built like the Live Preview panel.
records.translation: Panel för hyperparametersökning, byggd som panelen Live Preview.

records.context: Structurally this is the sibling of :mod:`spacr.qt.widgets.live_preview`: a self-contained :class:`QWidget` that owns its own controls, runs the expensive work on a :class:`QThread`, streams results back over signals, reports every failure inline (never in a modal — a QMessageBox hangs a headless run), and pushes a chosen configuration back into the host application view's settings panel through a callback the host registers. Host application views embed it with :func:`build_hyperparam_card`, exactly the way the Mask application view embeds the live preview, and toggle it with a label reading "Hyperparameter search" where the Mask application view's says "Live".
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.hyperparam#1
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: Structurally this is the sibling of :mod:`spacr.qt.widgets.live_preview`: a self-contained :class:`QWidget` that owns its own controls, runs the expensive work on a :class:`QThread`, streams results back over signals, reports every failure inline (never in a modal — a QMessageBox hangs a headless run), and pushes a chosen configuration back into the host screen's settings panel through a callback the host registers. Host screens embed it with :func:`build_hyperparam_card`, exactly the way the Mask screen embeds the live preview, and toggle it with a label reading "Hyperparameter search" where the Mask screen's says "Live".
records.translation: Strukturellt är detta ett syskon till :mod:`spacr.qt.widgets.live_preview`: en fristående :class:`QWidget` som äger sina egna kontroller, kör det kostsamma arbetet i en :class:`QThread`, strömmar tillbaka resultat via signaler, rapporterar varje fel i gränssnittet (aldrig i en modal dialog — en QMessageBox får en körning utan skärm att hänga sig) och för tillbaka en vald konfiguration till värdskärmens inställningspanel via ett återanrop som värden registrerar. Värdskärmar bäddar in den med :func:`build_hyperparam_card`, exakt på samma sätt som Mask-skärmen bäddar in liveförhandsvisningen, och växlar den med en etikett med texten "Hyperparameter search" där Mask-skärmens etikett säger "Live".

records.context: The panel does not report only a winner. The table is ordered by the criterion the user picked, and the panel also draws the small-multiples panel (embeddings for UMAP, score-versus-trial with the noise band for the machine-learning classification models) and prints the spread, the within-noise flag and the failure count, which show whether the best configuration differs meaningfully from the others. See :mod:`spacr.hyperparam` for why.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.hyperparam#2
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: The panel does not report only a winner. The table is ordered by the criterion the user picked, and the panel also draws the small-multiples panel (embeddings for UMAP, score-versus-trial with the noise band for the classifiers) and prints the spread, the within-noise flag and the failure count, which show whether the best configuration differs meaningfully from the others. See :mod:`spacr.hyperparam` for why.
records.translation: Panelen rapporterar inte bara en vinnare. Tabellen är ordnad efter det kriterium som användaren valde, och panelen ritar också small multiples-panelen (inbäddningar för UMAP, poäng mot försök med brusbandet för klassificerarna) och skriver ut spridningen, flaggan för inom brusnivån och antalet misslyckanden, vilket visar om den bästa konfigurationen skiljer sig meningsfullt från de andra. Se :mod:`spacr.hyperparam` för varför.

records.translation: **Skanningen skriver ingenting.** :func:`spacr.image_import.plan_import` går igenom ett urval av trädet och läser varje fils egna axelmetadata; ``Import`` är ett separat knapptryck, och den förblir inaktiverad medan planen har ett problem — eftersom varje problem som planen anger är ett sätt för resultatet att bli tyst felaktigt, och importen är den oåterkalleliga halvan.

records.context: **The proposal table is not editable, and the answer table is.** A wrong guess is never wrong for one file: it is wrong for a token position, in every name that has one. So the correction is made where the mistake lives, one answer fixing every file that shares it, rather than by retyping eight thousand rows. That is also the only correction :meth:`spacr.image_import.ImportPlan.with_mapping` can apply without re-walking the disk, which is what makes editing instant.

records.source: **The proposal table is not editable, and the answer table is.** A wrong guess is never wrong for one file: it is wrong for a token position, in every name that has one. So the correction is made where the mistake lives, one answer fixing every file that shares it, rather than by retyping eight thousand rows. That is also the only correction :meth:`spacr.image_import.ImportPlan.with_mapping` can apply without re-walking the disk, which is what makes editing instant.
records.translation: **Förslagstabellen är inte redigerbar, men svarstabellen är det.** En felaktig gissning är aldrig fel för en enda fil: den är fel för en tokenposition, i varje namn som har en. Därför görs korrigeringen där misstaget finns, så att ett svar rättar varje fil som delar det, i stället för att åttatusen rader skrivs in på nytt. Det är också den enda korrigering som :meth:`spacr.image_import.ImportPlan.with_mapping` kan tillämpa utan att gå igenom disken igen, vilket är det som gör redigeringen omedelbar.

records.source: **Everything the plan could not place is on screen**, with its values, and counted. Silence about unparsed files is how a plate imports with a third of its fields missing.
records.translation: **Allt som planen inte kunde placera visas på skärmen**, med sina värden, och räknas. Tystnad om otolkade filer är hur en platta importeras med en tredjedel av sina bildfält saknade.

records.context: **Off the main GUI execution path.** A scan reads every file's header; an import of a 400-plate archive takes minutes. Both go through :func:`spacr.qt.bridge.make_thread`, and the completion handler is reached through a *bound method* (:attr:`ImageImportScreen._job_settled`) rather than a closure, because ``PipelineWorker.finished`` is emitted in the background execution unit and a closure connected to it would build widget children there. Tests pass ``threaded=False``.

records.source: **Off the GUI thread.** A scan reads every file's header; an import of a 400-plate archive takes minutes. Tests pass ``threaded=False``.
records.translation: **Utanför GUI-tråden.** En skanning läser varje fils huvud; en import av ett arkiv med 400 plattor tar minuter. This screen shows those links as a tree, so questions such as which cells are uninfected, which pathogen is implausibly large for the cell around it, and which nucleus belongs to no cell at all can be answered by inspection.
records.translation: I ``measurements.db`` har raderna i ``nucleus`` och ``pathogen`` ett ``cell_id`` som namnger cellen de sitter i (:data:`spacr.schema.CHILD_OBJECT_TABLES`). Den här skärmen visar dessa länkar som ett träd, så att frågor som vilka celler som är oinfekterade, vilken patogen som är orimligt stor för cellen runt den och vilken kärna som inte tillhör någon cell alls kan besvaras genom inspektion.

records.context: What is on application view, and why each part is there. The findings table carries the observed rate and the rate expected by coincidence in adjacent columns, with the ratio between them beside both, because a rate alone cannot be told from an accident and this panel exists to stop somebody acting on one. The text window shows reads with their matches coloured by barcode type, because a barcode landing in the same columns on row after row is the evidence that settles an argument a percentage cannot. The proposal shows the value the form holds beside the value the search suggests, so what Apply is about to do is legible before it does it.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.map_barcodes.BarcodeSearchPanel#2
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: What is on screen, and why each part is there. The findings table carries the observed rate and the rate expected by coincidence in adjacent columns, with the ratio between them beside both, because a rate alone cannot be told from an accident and this panel exists to stop somebody acting on one. The text window shows reads with their matches coloured by barcode type, because a barcode landing in the same columns on row after row is the evidence that settles an argument a percentage cannot. The proposal shows the value the form holds beside the value the search suggests, so what Apply is about to do is legible before it does it.
records.translation: Vad som visas på skärmen, och varför varje del finns där. Fyndtabellen visar den observerade frekvensen och den frekvens som väntas av slump i intilliggande kolumner, med kvoten mellan dem bredvid båda, eftersom en frekvens ensam inte kan skiljas från en slump och panelen finns till för att hindra någon från att agera på en sådan. Textfönstret visar läsningar med matchningarna färgade efter streckkodstyp, eftersom en streckkod som hamnar i samma kolumner rad efter rad är det belägg som avgör en diskussion som en procentsats inte kan avgöra. Förslaget visar värdet som formuläret innehåller bredvid värdet som sökningen föreslår, så att det Apply ska göra går att läsa innan det görs.

records.context: The sequencing folder of a real screen holds several samples, and one of them is enough. Which mate carries which barcode, which orientation the reference tables are stored in relative to the reads, and where in the read the barcodes sit are all properties of the library and the sequencing run rather than of a sample, so measuring them on the first sample settles them for every sample beside it. The others are counted rather than read, and the count is reported so that nobody has to wonder whether they were forgotten.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.map_barcodes.plan_barcode_search#1
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context

Which mate carries which barcode, which orientation the reference tables are stored in relative to the reads, and where in the read the barcodes sit are all properties of the library and the sequencing run rather than of a sample, so measuring them on the first sample settles them for every sample beside it. The others are counted rather than read, and the count is reported so that nobody has to wonder whether they were forgotten.
records.translation: Sekvenseringsmappen för en verklig screening innehåller flera prov, och ett av dem räcker. Vilken parläsning som bär vilken streckkod, i vilken orientering referenstabellerna är lagrade i förhållande till läsningarna och var i läsningen streckkoderna sitter är alla egenskaper hos biblioteket och sekvenseringskörningen snarare än hos ett prov, så att mäta dem på det första provet avgör dem för varje prov bredvid. De andra räknas i stället för att läsas, och antalet rapporteras så att ingen behöver undra om de glömdes bort.

records.context: The hook is ``done``, not ``reject`` and not ``closeEvent`` alone. Escape reaches ``reject``, which hides the window WITHOUT a close event, and that would leave a measure run -- minutes of work, on an independent execution path -- going behind a window nobody can see; an executing ``QThread`` destroyed at exit aborts the process. Overriding ``reject`` to close instead would loop: ``QDialog.closeEvent`` itself calls ``reject``.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.measure_inputs.MeasureInputsScreen.done#1
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: The hook is ``done``, not ``reject`` and not ``closeEvent`` alone. Escape reaches ``reject``, which hides the window WITHOUT a close event, and that would leave a measure run -- minutes of work, on a thread -- going behind a window nobody can see; a running ``QThread`` destroyed at exit aborts the process. Overriding ``reject`` to close instead would loop: ``QDialog.closeEvent`` itself calls ``reject``.
records.translation: Kroken är ``done``, inte ``reject`` och inte enbart ``closeEvent``. Escape når ``reject``, som döljer fönstret UTAN en stängningshändelse, och det skulle lämna en mätkörning -- minuter av arbete, i en tråd -- igång bakom ett fönster som ingen kan se; en körande ``QThread`` som förstörs vid avslut avbryter processen. Att åsidosätta ``reject`` så att den stänger i stället skulle ge en loop: ``QDialog.closeEvent`` anropar själv ``reject``.

records.source: This screen assembles that into a **run digest** and turns it into two sections: **Methods** and **Results**.
records.translation: Den här skärmen sammanställer detta till en **körningssammanfattning** och gör om den till två avsnitt: **Methods** och **Results**.

records.context: **The model never sees the data.** It sees the digest — numbers already computed — and writes prose around them. Then every number it wrote is checked back against the digest, and a draft carrying a figure that is not there is refused: the panel says which numbers were invented, keeps the model's text where you can read it, and shows the sections spaCR wrote from the digest instead. The result of the check is shown in the strip under the tabs.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.methods_export#3
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: **The model never sees the data.** It sees the digest — numbers already computed — and writes prose around them. Then every number it wrote is checked back against the digest, and a draft carrying a figure that is not there is refused: the panel says which numbers were invented, keeps the model's text where you can read it, and shows the sections spaCR wrote from the digest instead. The result of the check is shown in the strip under the tabs.
records.translation: **Modellen ser aldrig data.** Den ser sammanfattningen — tal som redan har beräknats — och skriver prosa runt dem. Sedan kontrolleras varje tal den skrev mot sammanfattningen, och ett utkast som innehåller en siffra som inte finns där avvisas: panelen säger vilka tal som hittades på, behåller modellens text där du kan läsa den och visar i stället de avsnitt som spaCR skrev utifrån sammanfattningen. Resultatet av kontrollen visas i remsan under flikarna.

records.context: **With no AI configured it still works.** The deterministic renderer writes both sections from the same digest with no model at all. The panel says which one produced what you are looking at, and what to install if you want the other.

records.source: **With no AI configured it still works.** The deterministic renderer writes both sections from the same digest with no model at all. The panel says which one produced what you are looking at, and what to install if you want the other.
records.translation: **Utan konfigurerad AI fungerar det ändå.** Den deterministiska renderaren skriver båda avsnitten utifrån samma sammanfattning helt utan modell. Panelen säger vilken av dem som skapade det du tittar på, och vad du ska installera om du vill ha den andra.

records.context: **The caveats are not optional.** Which QC flags fired, whether illumination correction ran, the seed, the ``on_error`` policy and what it dropped, the machine-learning classification model's held-out metrics — the digest collects them and the Methods section has to state every one. A draft that drops one is refused for that alone.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.methods_export#5
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: **The caveats are not optional.** Which QC flags fired, whether illumination correction ran, the seed, the ``on_error`` policy and what it dropped, the classifier's held-out metrics — the digest collects them and the Methods section has to state every one. A draft that drops one is refused for that alone.
records.translation: **Förbehållen är inte valfria.** Vilka QC-flaggor som utlöstes, om belysningskorrigering kördes, fröet, ``on_error``-policyn och vad den tog bort, klassificerarens mått på undanhållna data — sammanfattningen samlar in dem och avsnittet Methods måste ange vart och ett. Ett utkast som utelämnar ett av dem avvisas enbart av det skälet.

records.source: Model Compare: run two Cellpose models on the same fields and compare them.
records.translation: Model Compare: kör två Cellpose-modeller på samma bildfält och jämför dem.

records.context: Without this screen, choosing a segmentation model means executing a laboratory microplate, looking at montages, changing one number and executing it again. Here the comparison executes on a few microscope fields of view: choose a folder, take three microscope fields of view (the default), configure two models, press Compare. The masks come back side by side over the same image with the object counts, the ARI and the split/merge attribution underneath.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.model_compare#1
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: Without this screen, choosing a segmentation model means running a plate, looking at montages, changing one number and running it again. Here the comparison runs on a few fields: choose a folder, take three fields (the default), configure two models, press Compare. The masks come back side by side over the same image with the object counts, the ARI and the split/merge attribution underneath.
records.translation: Utan den här skärmen innebär valet av segmenteringsmodell att köra en platta, titta på montage, ändra ett tal och köra igen. Här körs jämförelsen på några få bildfält: välj en mapp, ta tre bildfält (standard), konfigurera två modeller, tryck på Compare. Maskerna kommer tillbaka sida vid sida över samma bild med objektantalen, ARI och attributionen av delningar/sammanslagningar nedanför.

records.context: **The resolved-parameter table.** Cellpose 4 accepts ``model_type``, ``diam_mean``, ``nchan``, ``channels`` and ``rescale`` and then ignores every one of them, and it resolves all the pre-SAM model names to ``cpsam``. A comparison that differs only in one of those reports "no difference", which reads as "the models are equivalent" rather than "you changed nothing". So the application view shows what actually reached each model, marks what was dropped, and says so in a banner above the numbers.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.model_compare#4
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: **The resolved-parameter table.** Cellpose 4 accepts ``model_type``, ``diam_mean``, ``nchan``, ``channels`` and ``rescale`` and then ignores every one of them, and it resolves all the pre-SAM model names to ``cpsam``. A comparison that differs only in one of those reports "no difference", which reads as "the models are equivalent" rather than "you changed nothing". So the screen shows what actually reached each model, marks what was dropped, and says so in a banner above the numbers.
records.translation: **Tabellen över upplösta parametrar.** Cellpose 4 accepterar ``model_type``, ``diam_mean``, ``nchan``, ``channels`` och ``rescale`` och ignorerar sedan var och en av dem, och den löser upp alla modellnamn från före SAM till ``cpsam``. En jämförelse som bara skiljer sig i en av dessa rapporterar "no difference" (ingen skillnad), vilket läses som "the models are equivalent" (modellerna är likvärdiga) snarare än "you changed nothing" (du ändrade ingenting). Därför visar skärmen vad som faktiskt nådde varje modell, markerar vad som togs bort och säger det i en banderoll ovanför talen.

records.context: **Off the main GUI execution path.** Loading microscope fields of view and segmentation can both be slow on a laboratory microplate or NAS path, so they go through :func:`spacr.qt.bridge.make_thread` like every other spaCR job. Tests pass ``threaded=False``, which runs the same code inline.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.model_compare#5
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: **Off the GUI thread.** Loading fields and segmentation can both be slow on a plate or NAS path, so they go through :func:`spacr.qt.bridge.make_thread` like every other spaCR job. Tests pass ``threaded=False``, which runs the same code inline.
records.translation: **Utanför GUI-tråden.** Att läsa in bildfält och segmentera kan båda vara långsamt på en platta eller en NAS-sökväg, så de går via :func:`spacr.qt.bridge.make_thread` precis som alla andra spaCR-jobb. Testerna skickar ``threaded=False``, som kör samma kod direkt.

records.context: **Provenance is a column, not a tooltip.** "What was this trained on" is what decides whether a model applies to your images at all, so it is in the table and spelled ``unknown`` where it is unknown — a blank cell reads as "no constraints", which is the opposite of what it means.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.model_zoo#4
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: **Provenance is a column, not a tooltip.** "What was this trained on" is what decides whether a model applies to your images at all, so it is in the table and spelled ``unknown`` where it is unknown — a blank cell reads as "no constraints", which is the opposite of what it means.
records.translation: **Ursprung är en kolumn, inte ett verktygstips.** "Vad tränades den här på" är det som avgör om en modell alls är tillämplig på dina bilder, så det finns i tabellen och skrivs ``unknown`` där det är okänt — en tom cell läses som "no constraints" (inga begränsningar), vilket är motsatsen till vad den betyder.

records.context: **Downloads are off the main GUI execution path, atomic, and cancellable.** The bytes go to a temp file inside the destination and are renamed only after the checksum passes (:func:`spacr.model_zoo.fetch`), so Cancel leaves the destination exactly as it was — no half-written file at a name that looks like a model.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.model_zoo#5
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: **Downloads are off the GUI thread, atomic, and cancellable.** The bytes go to a temp file inside the destination and are renamed only after the checksum passes (:func:`spacr.model_zoo.fetch`), so Cancel leaves the destination exactly as it was — no half-written file at a name that looks like a model.
records.translation: **Nedladdningar sker utanför GUI-tråden, atomärt och kan avbrytas.** Byten går till en temporär fil i målet och byter namn först när kontrollsumman stämmer (:func:`spacr.model_zoo.fetch`), så Cancel lämnar målet exakt som det var — ingen halvskriven fil under ett namn som ser ut som en modell.

records.context: **No modal dialogs on any error path.** A folder with no models, a checksum mismatch, a corrupt checkpoint, a cancelled download: all inline. A QMessageBox hangs a headless run.

records.source: **No modal dialogs on any error path.** A folder with no models, a checksum mismatch, a corrupt checkpoint, a cancelled download: all inline. A QMessageBox hangs a headless run.

records.context: Filter, then decompose

records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: Filter, then decompose
records.translation: Filtrera, dekomponera sedan

records.context: A filter change **recomputes** the decomposition rather than just re-drawing it. PCA is a property of a population: the centre, the scale and the component directions are all computed from the rows in it. Keeping the old components and dropping the filtered points would draw a plot whose axes belong to a population the user is no longer looking at — the scores would still be in the old basis, and a cluster that separates in the filtered subset would not appear. So the filter is upstream of the maths, the recomputation is debounced, and the report under the plot re-states the row count every time.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.pca#8
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: A filter change **recomputes** the decomposition rather than just re-drawing it. PCA is a property of a population: the centre, the scale and the component directions are all computed from the rows in it. Keeping the old components and dropping the filtered points would draw a plot whose axes belong to a population the user is no longer looking at — the scores would still be in the old basis, and a cluster that separates in the filtered subset would not appear. So the filter is upstream of the maths, the recomputation is debounced, and the report under the plot re-states the row count every time.
records.translation: En filterändring **beräknar om** dekompositionen i stället för att bara rita om den. PCA är en egenskap hos en population: centrum, skalan och komponentriktningarna beräknas alla från raderna i den. Att behålla de gamla komponenterna och ta bort de filtrerade punkterna skulle rita ett diagram vars axlar tillhör en population som användaren inte längre tittar på — poängen skulle fortfarande ligga i den gamla basen, och ett kluster som separerar i den filtrerade delmängden skulle inte synas. Därför ligger filtret uppströms om matematiken, omberäkningen fördröjs och rapporten under diagrammet anger radantalet på nytt varje gång.

records.translation: Tre avsiktliga val:

records.context: **The graph is drawn from provenance, not from the module list.** What the workflow is *supposed* to do is :data:`spacr.ports.PORTS`, and that is drawn too — dimmed, underneath, as the "declared order" strip — but the boxes and arrows are what actually happened. A project where measure read last week's masks is drawn with that history, which differs from the declared diagram.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.pipeline_graph#5
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: **The graph is drawn from provenance, not from the module list.** What the pipeline is *supposed* to do is :data:`spacr.ports.PORTS`, and that is drawn too — dimmed, underneath, as the "declared order" strip — but the boxes and arrows are what actually happened. A project where measure read last week's masks is drawn with that history, which differs from the declared diagram.
records.translation: **Grafen ritas utifrån ursprung, inte utifrån modullistan.** Det som pipelinen *ska* göra är :data:`spacr.ports.PORTS`, och det ritas också — nedtonat, underst, som remsan "declared order" (deklarerad ordning) — men rutorna och pilarna är det som faktiskt hände. Ett projekt där measure läste förra veckans masker ritas med den historiken, som skiljer sig från det deklarerade diagrammet.

records.context: **Missing is not stale.** A deleted file is red and says so; an outdated one is amber. :mod:`spacr.artifacts` refuses to conflate them and neither does this.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.pipeline_graph#6
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: **Missing is not stale.** A deleted file is red and says so; an outdated one is amber. :mod:`spacr.artifacts` refuses to conflate them and neither does this.
records.translation: **Saknad är inte detsamma som inaktuell.** En borttagen fil är röd och säger det; en inaktuell är bärnstensgul. :mod:`spacr.artifacts` vägrar att blanda ihop dem och det gör inte heller den här skärmen.

records.context: **Nothing here writes.** No repeat-execution button, no "mark as fresh", no delete. The screen answers a question; acting on the answer is the module's job, and a one-click execute again wired to a graph is how somebody overwrites the artifact they were trying to check.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.pipeline_graph#7
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: **Nothing here writes.** No re-run button, no "mark as fresh", no delete. The screen answers a question; acting on the answer is the module's job, and a one-click re-run wired to a graph is how somebody overwrites the artifact they were trying to check.
records.translation: **Ingenting här skriver.** Ingen omkörningsknapp, ingen "mark as fresh" (markera som aktuell), ingen borttagning. Skärmen besvarar en fråga; att agera på svaret är modulens uppgift, och en omkörning med ett klick kopplad till en graf är hur någon skriver över den artefakt de försökte kontrollera.

records.context: ``recompute()`` returns a bool that a caller reads, and it means "a plate was drawn **or is being drawn**" rather than "a plate was drawn". The refusals -- no frame yet, and a failed aggregation -- are unchanged and still synchronous, because the first does no work and the second is reported by the completion handler in exactly the place it was reported before. So the only caller-visible difference is that ``True`` may arrive before the grid is painted.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.plate_view.PlateViewScreen.recompute#2

records.source: ``recompute()`` returns a bool that a caller reads, and it means "a plate was drawn **or is being drawn**" rather than "a plate was drawn". The refusals -- no frame yet, and a failed aggregation -- are unchanged and still synchronous, because the first does no work and the second is reported by the completion handler in exactly the place it was reported before. So the only caller-visible difference is that ``True`` may arrive before the grid is painted.
records.translation: ``recompute()`` returnerar en bool som en anropare läser, och den betyder "a plate was drawn **or is being drawn**" (en platta ritades eller håller på att ritas) snarare än "a plate was drawn" (en platta ritades). Avvisningarna -- ingen ram ännu, och en misslyckad aggregering -- är oförändrade och fortfarande synkrona, eftersom den första inte gör något arbete och den andra rapporteras av slutförandehanteraren på exakt samma ställe som den rapporterades tidigare. Den enda skillnad som anroparen kan se är alltså att ``True`` kan komma innan rutnätet har målats.

records.context: ``threaded=False`` (which every test in ``test_plate_view.py`` and ``test_plate_view_linked_filter.py`` constructs the screen with) runs the job inline through :meth:`_run_job`, so those callers still get the old meaning exactly. A caller that needs to know the grid is up waits on :meth:`active_jobs`, as ``render_plate``'s callers already do -- ``render_plate`` has returned "started, not finished" since the database read was with worker execution, and this is the same promise.

This screen shows that: one input is swept and the others are held at chosen values.
records.translation: En koefficienttabell säger vilka termer som spelar roll. Den visar inte vad modellen förutsäger för en viss brunn, eller hur prediktionen ändras när andelen för en gRNA fördubblas medan de övriga indata hålls fasta. Den här skärmen visar just det: en indata sveps och de andra hålls på valda värden.

records.context: The left column is :func:`spacr.profiler.sensitivity` — every input ranked by how far it actually moves the prediction, not by its coefficient, because a large coefficient on an input that never varies moves nothing. In a design with thousands of terms, the ranking shows which input to profile first.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.profiler#2
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: The left column is :func:`spacr.profiler.sensitivity` — every input ranked by how far it actually moves the prediction, not by its coefficient, because a large coefficient on an input that never varies moves nothing. In a design with thousands of terms, the ranking shows which input to profile first.
records.translation: Den vänstra kolumnen är :func:`spacr.profiler.sensitivity` — varje indata rangordnad efter hur mycket den faktiskt flyttar prediktionen, inte efter sin koefficient, eftersom en stor koefficient på en indata som aldrig varierar inte flyttar något. I en design med tusentals termer visar rangordningen vilken indata som ska profileras först.

records.context: **Nothing is re-fitted.** The screen reads a coefficient table a regression processing session already wrote and wraps it in :class:`spacr.profiler.FittedLinear`, which is *reading* the fit. Re-fitting would show a second model under the first one's name, and on a penalised backend with ``alpha='auto'`` its coefficients can differ. A caller that has a live fitted object can hand it straight to :meth:`ProfilerScreen.set_model` and skip the file entirely.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.profiler#3
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: **Nothing is re-fitted.** The screen reads a coefficient table a regression run already wrote and wraps it in :class:`spacr.profiler.FittedLinear`, which is *reading* the fit. Re-fitting would show a second model under the first one's name, and on a penalised backend with ``alpha='auto'`` its coefficients can differ. A caller that has a live fitted object can hand it straight to :meth:`ProfilerScreen.set_model` and skip the file entirely.
records.translation: **Ingenting anpassas om.** Skärmen läser en koefficienttabell som en regressionskörning redan har skrivit och omsluter den i :class:`spacr.profiler.FittedLinear`, som *läser* anpassningen. En omanpassning skulle visa en andra modell under den förstas namn, och på en penaliserad backend med ``alpha='auto'`` kan dess koefficienter skilja sig. En anropare som har ett levande anpassat objekt kan lämna det direkt till :meth:`ProfilerScreen.set_model` och hoppa över filen helt.

records.context: **The link is named, not guessed.** A coefficient table does not record which inverse link produced it, and applying the wrong one draws a plausible curve on the wrong scale. So the link is a control the user sets, it defaults to identity, and the axis label always says which one is in force.

records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context

records.translation: **Länkfunktionen namnges, den gissas inte.** En koefficienttabell registrerar inte vilken invers länkfunktion som gav den, och att tillämpa fel länkfunktion ritar en rimlig kurva på fel skala. Därför är länkfunktionen en kontroll som användaren ställer in, den är som standard identitet, och axeletiketten anger alltid vilken som gäller.

records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: **A project the registry has never seen is still listed.** Projects are found by walking the disk, so a folder copied from a colleague appears the moment the browser is pointed at its parent — with its stage, its size and the date its files were last written. What it does *not* show is "0 stale", which would read as *clean*: with no provenance there is nothing to compare against, so the state column says "unknown — nothing recorded" and the note says why.
records.translation: **Ett projekt som registret aldrig har sett listas ändå.** Projekt hittas genom att disken gås igenom, så en mapp som kopierats från en kollega visas så snart bläddraren pekas på dess föräldramapp — med sitt stadium, sin storlek och datumet då dess filer senast skrevs. Det den *inte* visar är "0 stale", som skulle läsas som *ren*: utan ursprungsuppgifter finns det inget att jämföra med, så tillståndskolumnen säger "unknown — nothing recorded" (okänt — ingenting registrerat) och anteckningen förklarar varför.

records.context: **And neither does opening the application view, nor opening its folder chooser.** Two things here take a path the user typed on some *other* application view: the search folders :func:`make_project_browser_screen` seeds from the recent-source list, and the folder the "Add folder…" dialog starts in. Neither is checked with ``os.path.isdir`` on the main GUI execution path: measured on one workstation, one such folder was under an ``autofs`` mount whose share was asleep, and a single ``isdir`` on it had not returned after twenty seconds, freezing the whole application with no traceback. Both ask :mod:`spacr.qt.path_probe`, which answers from a cache and stats in the background. Those two are the whole inventory: the walk executes on a worker, and every column, note and detail line the application view draws is rendered from the frozen :class:`spacr.projects.ProjectSummary` that walk already returned, so filling the table and the detail pane reads nothing.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.project_browser#6
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: **And neither does opening the screen, nor opening its folder chooser.** Two things here take a path the user typed on some *other* screen: the search folders :func:`make_project_browser_screen` seeds from the recent-source list, and the folder the "Add folder…" dialog starts in. Neither is checked with ``os.path.isdir`` on the GUI thread: measured on one workstation, one such folder was under an ``autofs`` mount whose share was asleep, and a single ``isdir`` on it had not returned after twenty seconds, freezing the whole application with no traceback. Both ask :mod:`spacr.qt.path_probe`, which answers from a cache and stats in the background. Those two are the whole inventory: the walk runs on a worker, and every column, note and detail line the screen draws is rendered from the frozen :class:`spacr.projects.ProjectSummary` that walk already returned, so filling the table and the detail pane reads nothing.
records.translation: **Och det gör inte heller öppnandet av skärmen eller av dess mappväljare.** Två saker här tar en sökväg som användaren skrivit på någon *annan* skärm: de sökmappar som :func:`make_project_browser_screen` fyller i från listan över senaste källor, och den mapp som dialogen "Add folder…" startar i. Ingen av dem kontrolleras med ``os.path.isdir`` i GUI-tråden: uppmätt på en arbetsstation låg en sådan mapp under en ``autofs``-montering vars nätverksresurs hade somnat, och ett enda ``isdir`` på den hade inte returnerat efter tjugo sekunder, vilket frös hela programmet utan någon traceback. Båda frågar :mod:`spacr.qt.path_probe`, som svarar från en cache och gör stat-anropen i bakgrunden. De två är hela inventariet: genomgången körs i en arbetstråd, och varje kolumn, anteckning och detaljrad som skärmen ritar renderas från den frysta :class:`spacr.projects.ProjectSummary` som genomgången redan returnerade, så att fylla tabellen och detaljrutan läser ingenting.

records.context: It **reads**; it does not score. So the reads go through a fingerprint cache -- one listdir and one stat per artifact -- and the parse only happens when something on disk has actually changed.
records.translation: Den **läser**; den poängsätter inte. Regeln kommer från :mod:`spacr.qt.prerun`, och den modulen förklarar varför: att öppna en plattas masker kostar sekunder till minuter, vilket är för långsamt att upprepa vid varje besök. Därför går läsningarna via en fingeravtryckscache -- en listdir och en stat per artefakt -- och tolkningen sker bara när något på disken faktiskt har ändrats.

records.context: ``_QueueRunner`` is parented to this widget and executes whole workflows, so its independent execution path can be hours long. Destroying the application view with it executing deletes a live QThread, which Qt answers with ``qFatal("QThread: Destroyed while thread is still running")``. It also does not go through :func:`spacr.qt.bridge.make_thread`, so the process-wide run registry — and therefore ``MainWindow.closeEvent``'s drain — cannot see it.

records.source: ``_QueueRunner`` is parented to this widget and executes whole pipelines, so its thread can be hours long. Destroying the screen with it running deletes a live QThread, which Qt answers with ``qFatal("QThread: Destroyed while thread is still running")``. It also does not go through :func:`spacr.qt.bridge.make_thread`, so the process-wide run registry — and therefore ``MainWindow.closeEvent``'s drain — cannot see it.
records.translation: ``_QueueRunner`` har den här widgeten som förälder och kör hela pipelines, så dess tråd kan pågå i timmar. Att förstöra skärmen medan den körs tar bort en levande QThread, vilket Qt besvarar med ``qFatal("QThread: Destroyed while thread is still running")``. Den går inte heller via :func:`spacr.qt.bridge.make_thread`, så processens gemensamma körningsregister — och därmed tömningen i ``MainWindow.closeEvent`` — kan inte se den.

records.context: Three screening experiments continue from a regression's coefficients, and none of them duplicates anything the results panel does:
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.regression#1
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: Three screens continue from a regression's coefficients, and none of them duplicates anything the results panel does:
records.translation: Tre skärmar fortsätter från en regressions koefficienter, och ingen av dem duplicerar något som resultatpanelen gör:

records.context: **Hit List** displays one ranked row per gene for the loaded regression processing session. Backends that report p-values receive Benjamini–Hochberg q-values computed across the genes tested; penalised backends instead rank by bootstrap selection frequency and do not report q-values. Each row includes the effect estimate, a 95% interval when a standard error is available, and gRNA sign agreement when guide-level coefficients are available. Annotation CSVs are collapsed to one row per gene before validated many-to-one joins. The complete :class:`~spacr.qt.screens.hit_list.HitListScreen` is installed as the **Hits** tab after Guide support, follows the processing session loaded by the results panel, and exports the displayed filtered list as CSV, Markdown, or self-contained HTML.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.regression#3
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: **Hit List** displays one ranked row per gene for the loaded regression run. Backends that report p-values receive Benjamini–Hochberg q-values computed across the genes tested; penalised backends instead rank by bootstrap selection frequency and do not report q-values. Each row includes the effect estimate, a 95% interval when a standard error is available, and gRNA sign agreement when guide-level coefficients are available. Annotation CSVs are collapsed to one row per gene before validated many-to-one joins. The complete :class:`~spacr.qt.screens.hit_list.HitListScreen` is installed as the **Hits** tab after Guide support, follows the run loaded by the results panel, and exports the displayed filtered list as CSV, Markdown, or self-contained HTML.
records.translation: **Hit List** visar en rangordnad rad per gen för den inlästa regressionskörningen. Backends som rapporterar p-värden får Benjamini–Hochberg-q-värden beräknade över de testade generna; penaliserade backends rangordnar i stället efter urvalsfrekvens i bootstrap och rapporterar inga q-värden. Varje rad innehåller effektskattningen, ett 95%-intervall när ett standardfel finns tillgängligt och teckenöverensstämmelse för gRNA när koefficienter på guidenivå finns tillgängliga. Annoterings-CSV-filer slås ihop till en rad per gen före validerade många-till-en-sammanfogningar. Den fullständiga :class:`~spacr.qt.screens.hit_list.HitListScreen` installeras som fliken **Hits** efter Guide support, följer den körning som resultatpanelen läst in och exporterar den visade filtrerade listan som CSV, Markdown eller fristående HTML.

records.context: **Methods & Results** builds the processing-session digest -- package versions, timings, seed and error policy, per-module parameters parsed out of the emitted macro, the segmentation verdict, artifact counts, held-out metrics -- drafts the two sections from it and then mechanically checks every number in the draft back against the digest. It opens seeded with the project the regression screen is already pointed at, so the path it otherwise asks the user to type is filled in.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.regression#4
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: **Methods & Results** builds the run digest -- package versions, timings, seed and error policy, per-module parameters parsed out of the emitted macro, the segmentation verdict, artifact counts, held-out metrics -- drafts the two sections from it and then mechanically checks every number in the draft back against the digest. It opens seeded with the project the regression screen is already pointed at, so the path it otherwise asks the user to type is filled in.
records.translation: **Methods & Results** bygger körningssammanfattningen -- paketversioner, tider, frö och felpolicy, parametrar per modul tolkade ur det genererade makrot, segmenteringsbedömningen, artefaktantal, mått på undanhållna data -- skriver utkast till de två avsnitten utifrån den och kontrollerar sedan mekaniskt varje tal i utkastet mot sammanfattningen. Den öppnas förifylld med det projekt som regressionsskärmen redan pekar på, så att den sökväg som användaren annars ombeds skriva in är ifylld.

records.context: It is also named in ``spacr.qt.app._SELF_REGISTERING_APPS`` and in :data:`spacr.qt.SELF_REGISTERING_MODULES`. records.translation: Den namnges också i ``spacr.qt.app._SELF_REGISTERING_APPS`` och i :data:`spacr.qt.SELF_REGISTERING_MODULES`. records.context: When the active tab changes, settings named by the ``cellpose_masks`` propagation map in :mod:`spacr.qt.preview_registry` are copied to the destination tab when that tab exposes the corresponding setting. ``src`` and ``model_name`` are not copied. On entry to Apply, the workbench searches ``<train-src>/models/cellpose_model/models`` for checkpoints whose names begin with the Train tab's ``model_name``. It prefers completed checkpoints over periodic ``_epoch_`` checkpoints and selects the most recently modified candidate from the preferred group. If found, that path is assigned to ``custom_model``, which :func:`spacr.spacr_cellpose.identify_masks_finetune` resolves before ``model_name``; otherwise, Apply retains its current model selection.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.train_cellpose#2
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: When the active tab changes, settings named by the ``cellpose_masks`` propagation map in :mod:`spacr.qt.preview_registry` are copied to the destination tab when that tab exposes the corresponding setting. ``src`` and ``model_name`` are not copied. On entry to Apply, the workbench searches ``<train-src>/models/cellpose_model/models`` for checkpoints whose names begin with the Train tab's ``model_name``. It prefers completed checkpoints over periodic ``_epoch_`` checkpoints and selects the most recently modified candidate from the preferred group. If found, that path is assigned to ``custom_model``, which :func:`spacr.spacr_cellpose.identify_masks_finetune` resolves before ``model_name``; otherwise, Apply retains its current model selection.
records.translation: När den aktiva fliken byts kopieras de inställningar som namnges av propageringskartan för ``cellpose_masks`` i :mod:`spacr.qt.preview_registry` till målfliken när den fliken exponerar motsvarande inställning. ``src`` och ``model_name`` kopieras inte. Vid inträde i Apply söker arbetsbänken i ``<train-src>/models/cellpose_model/models`` efter kontrollpunkter vars namn börjar med ``model_name`` från fliken Train. Den föredrar färdiga kontrollpunkter framför periodiska ``_epoch_``-kontrollpunkter och väljer den senast ändrade kandidaten i den föredragna gruppen. Om en sådan hittas tilldelas den sökvägen till ``custom_model``, som :func:`spacr.spacr_cellpose.identify_masks_finetune` löser upp före ``model_name``; annars behåller Apply sitt aktuella modellval.

records.context: **Discovery runs off the main GUI execution path.** A scan walks a model tree and parses every progress CSV under it, which on a real screen is hundreds of files. It goes through :func:`spacr.qt.bridge.make_thread` like every other spaCR job; tests pass ``threaded=False``, which runs the same code inline. Drawing stays on the main GUI execution path — by then the data is already in memory.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.train_compare#4
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: **Discovery runs off the GUI thread.** A scan walks a model tree and parses every progress CSV under it, which on a real screen is hundreds of files. It goes through :func:`spacr.qt.bridge.make_thread` like every other spaCR job; tests pass ``threaded=False``, which runs the same code inline. Drawing stays on the GUI thread — by then the data is already in memory.
records.translation: **Identifieringen körs utanför GUI-tråden.** En skanning går igenom ett modellträd och tolkar varje förlopps-CSV under det, vilket för en verklig screening är hundratals filer. Den går via :func:`spacr.qt.bridge.make_thread` precis som alla andra spaCR-jobb; testerna skickar ``threaded=False``, som kör samma kod direkt. Ritningen sker i GUI-tråden — då finns data redan i minnet.
